mapper.select: SELECT cr.record_id, m.member_id, m.member_name, cr.class_id, ct.class_name, csel.employee_name AS coach_name, cr.coach_id, cr.join_time, cr.status, cr.total_sessions, cr.completed_sessions, cr.rating FROM class_record cr JOIN member m ON cr.member_id = m.member_id JOIN class_table ct ON cr.class_id = ct.class_id LEFT JOIN employee csel ON cr.coach_id = csel.employee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_record (member_id, class_id, coach_id, total_sessions, completed_sessions) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{classId}, #{coachId}, #{totalSessions}, #{completedSessions})
